author: mara
story: A chat assistant for Ops with suggestions, where the smart model calls four read connectors as tools (run by the platform as the viewer). Tomas asks about Austrian and Czech charge points, both in the CEE countries his group covers, with the first exchange passed back as history.

input.message: Which charge points in Vienna are faulted right now?
And which open tickets are there for charge points in Prague?
